title: tobi/disktree
why_read: A practical, fast disk-usage visualization tool written in Rust for the Omarchy Linux setup, useful for everyday systems work.
analysis: Disktree is a treemap-based disk usage viewer, similar in spirit to tools like WinDirStat or Baobab, built in Rust using the GPUI graphics toolkit and tailored for the Omarchy environment. Treemap visualizations are a genuinely effective way to spot which folders or files are eating disk space at a glance. This is a solid, practical utility rather than a research breakthrough, appealing mainly to people who use or are curious about the Omarchy setup and want fast native tooling.
